NOTE BLOCK CONTENT:

*"Things are kicking off. More and more kaiju are crawling out of the ether. And by crawling, I mean romping with the grace of a toddler destroying a cityscape of sandcastles, drawing on the walls of a sacred temple, and letting out squeals of delight that bring avalanches crashing down. Innumerable earthquakes, incessant floods, unceasing tempests…you name it, we’re seeing it, and I hear you’re helpful. Or at least, that you’re low on gold. Subduing these creatures won’t be easy. They’re embodiments of nature and magic; I’m not even sure they can be killed. You might have to find out what makes them tick and stop it tocking. Knowledge will be the whetstone with which you’ll sharpen your wit, and with wit you’ll whittle them down, or something."

# History of Shen Ji

Shen Ji is a rich and prosperous lands, home to all manner of beast, creature and spirit. The realm have been shrouded in a mist that has cut them off from the surrounding planes for a millennium, if not more. The traditional gods and goddesses of the prime material and beyond can still communicate with Shen Ji, but anything short of deific magics cannot permeate the ever present mist that surrounds the realm. 

Despite this "seclusion" the beings of this place thrive, and have no desire to leave. The realms also harbors a unique ecosystem, one where the spirts of this realm, the Yokai, are present in all walks of life. Even more strange then the yokai though, are the [[#Kaiju]], colossal forces of nature that shape the very land they walk upon. 

It has been 1000 years since the [[Lei Shen]], and Shen Ji has known relative peace. A time during which the realm has prospered, allowing for the blossoming of society and order. It seems that time of peace and prosperity may be threatened, as in the past few years, the ground itself has begun to sunder, the mountains have begun to move, the storms have begun to rage. Kaiju have been spotted.
# [[Kaiju]]

Kaiju are gargantuan creatures that inhabit Shen Ji. These forces of nature take many forms, massive kabuto beetles, bipedal Raiju, or leviathans made of spiritual water, but share one common trait: their existence shapes the very realm itself. These creatures can cleave mountains with a swipe of a tail, flood a valley with wanton breath, and level entire towns when lying down to rest. Each kaiju is motivated by it's own personal agenda, these creatures are not controlled or manipulated for some higher purpose, they simply exist as sheer power incarnate. 

Kaiju cannot truly be slain, no more so than a storm can be "killed". The death of a kaiju signals the beginning of a cycle of rebirth, some thousands of years in the future, it will be reborn again, ready to wreck havoc once more.  

## Homebrew Kaiju 

### Chameleon Kaiju 

The kaiju who attacked the Blue Blaze in [[Muchu-Nata]]'s backstory. This kaiju was exercising its intense territorial nature in preparation for mating season. It attacked anything that broke through its pheromone boundary, and was preparing it's nest for a mating dance. 

Cloaked killer who uses camouflage tactics to ambush others with swift and lethal force. It is highly territorial and will attack anything that breaks through its pheromone boundary.  

### Iron Wyrm

A massive iron bodied dragon kaiju who attacked the Hulking Enkoh in the Kitikami Mountains ([Tie Xueren's village]). 

A Kaiju of direct opposition to the Raiju, the Iron Wyrm's are at odds with the lightening wielding tigers.

The last great emperor of Shen Ji, history remembers Lei Shen as the great kaiju slayer and bringer of a time of peace. History tends to forget that Lei Shen was a ruthless leader, bringing Shen Ji under the banner of the Thunder King, one of strict law and code. It was said that Lei Shen commanded the power of the storm itself, able summon and bend the power of lightning, and with this power, he was able to defeat the kaiju of the past. 

Lei Shen was born to a royal family of oniborne. The strongest of his siblings he was born to be great, and great he was. Lei Shen aspired for much more than just dominion over his nomadic troop. He saw the power of his people, the power of his claim, and decided he would unite all of Shen Ji under his banner. He sought to tame and destroy the kaiju that ravaged the land, seeing a future where the denizens of Shen Ji could be the rulers of the land, not the kaiju. In the years that followed Lei Shen led a conquest across the lands, uniting the races and tribes under his banner through all means of conquest. For those that could be reasoned with, Lei Shen offered a vision of a Shen Ji ruled by order and prosperity under a single banner. For those who could not, Lei Shen split the heavens with his righteous [[#Power of the Storm]] and made those who opposed him bend the knee. 10 years of conquest, and Lei Shen began the [[#Reign of the Thunder King]]. 
## Power of the Storm

Lei Shen stole a tempest bead from a Raiju while it slumbered. He then had a powerful shaman fuse the bead with himself, granting him great powers of thunder and lightening. He then used the very power of the kaiju to slay them and bring about the years of peace the realm knows now. 
## Reign of the Thunder King

At the start of his reign, the Thunder King led [[#The Hunt of Thunder]] to cleanse the kaiju from the realm. With Shen Ji's people free from the immense force of these behemoths, the emperor could begin to build his empire.

Lei Shen ruled Shen Ji through strength and wit. He united the people of the land under a single unified language (common). He created a single system of weight and currency that laid the foundation for society today. His reign saw the strict enforcement of law and order, with insurrection and rebellion punished by public evisceration and execution. Any and all who opposed his rule were subjected and enslaved. 

He erected the walled city of [[Puyi]], the capital of his empire which lied in the center of the [[Puyi#Thunder Plains|Thunder Plains]]. 

# The Hunt of Thunder

Once united under his powerful banner, Lei Shen began his hunt of the kaiju. Wielding the power of a Raiju infused into his body, and legions thousands strong, he was a force to be reckoned with. NOTE BLOCK CONTENT:

The primary metropolitan center of Shen Ji, Puyi serves as the hub of trade and culture in the realm. Puyi is walled city, erected by the last great emperor of Shen Ji, [[Lei Shen]]. The city now serves as the the nexus for political and economic production, with an outlet to the sea along the Imini River, fed from the Kitikami Mountains. 

The city of Puyi was originally founded during lei Shen's rule and served as the "Rome" of his rule. The city was used to establish a cultural hub and served as the major nexus point for the gathering of the armies under his rule. As such the original ancient city was surrounded by large walls and borders the Imini river which runs both through and aside the city. From here Lei shen built the docks that allowed for ship building that later defined the northern coast, the umigiri coast as the ships left their inland post. 

Modern day Puyi is governed by a city council, a primary body of 4 Mildred Vex of Mildreds Magical MagicBox who represents the interest of the merchants of the city, the dean of the college of Hanabi, Ryu the head Chronicler at the Library of the Chroniclers, and Captain Georgio (High level Cleric) , First plume of the Pegasus Guard of Puyi.  This city council votes and discusses the usage of Puyis resources, representing each of the relevant factions of the city. The council rotates responsibly for presenting and speaking to the public regarding public events, and also each carry with them a advisory council of 2 people. The advisory council is also allowed to vote during major decisions but doesn't not speak for the group, the idea being that an individual council member cannot corrupt the decisions of any given faction. These council members are chosen by the other members of the council.

# 3 Unique Things

1. The city of Puyi has aqueducts that move water throughout the city. Many of the aqueducts also have multipurpose of carrying small boats that delivery packages and letters serving as both a distribution system and a water system. The Aqueducts have been enchanted by the college of Hanabi to control flow direction by using bernoullis eq to decrease nozzle size on either aquifer hub. The city lies on a large vertical axis, the "ground" floor of puyi is level with the top of the large wall, with the guts lying directly underneath. 
2.  The city of Puyi has an augmented time control due to the work of the Chronomancer's. The richer area of town, near the promenade, and the moor of merchants has a bubble of arcane runes that cause time to pass 30% slower in that area of the city. 
3. The city is surrounded by an ancient stone wall that has stood for thousands of years.

## Thunder Plains

- What it is: ~7 days of travel from the edge of the city lie the thunder plains, a rolling expanse of flatlands where roaming nomadic peoples live in addition to many plains beasts and herd animals. The thunder plains house many manner of beasts, some magical and some not. Many hunters prowl the plains, bringing back meats and hunted game to the city to trade with. 

-  **Why it’s untamed/unclaimed:**  The plains are massive spanning all around the central city of Puyi with many nomadic peoples living amongst it. 
Thunder Plains Cows
![[Pasted image 20260701204013.png|334]]
- Why it’s adventure worthy: The Large flatlands are home to marauders and nomadic bands of peoples. Some of them are pirate-like and target stealing from travelers. Some of the nomadic bands have some treasure that is kept by the regional warlords. There has been tell of a warlord who has begun to unite the nomadic tribes under a single banner who goes by the name Volsung Fa. 
	- Fa believes that uniting the people under a single banner will lead the people of the plains to a strength they have never known before
	- Once united under his banner he plans to move the people north to the Umigiri coast to learn the ways of the ships and the sea
	- Fa believes in conquest and seeks to slay the greatest beasts of the land, turing his sights to the kaiju as well
	- Fa is not a blood thirsty killer, he seeks to try the might of those around him
- The players will encounter 3d4 member of the [[#Pegasus Guard Headquarters]] who are search for Volsung Fa as they have heard the rumors in the city of Puyi of Fa and his escapades. They have been sent to investigate but were warned to not engage with Fa or his forces. 
- The guard is forthcoming and will let the party know the following: 

1. Volsung Fa is a massive orc who leads a nomadic group of warriors who call themselves the Wind of the Plains. 
2. Volsung Fa is a massive orc who wears a tank like armor covered in iron spikes![[Pasted image 20260701191541.png|284]]
3. The first plume of the guard, captain Georgio has sent them to investigate Fa and his roving band, there has been rumblings that he means to unite the plains people under a single banner, which has some of the citizens of Puyi quite concerned. 
4. They will also divulge rumors about [[#Evernight Gate]], and [[#Thunderbird Point]]

## Evernight Gate

- **Why it’s interesting:** A massive gate of ancient stone that shows night on the other side. It stands between two hills. Without passing through it, the Gealach hills remain normal, but if one passes through the Gate, the hills are in a state of always night, and a full moon hangs above. The geography is the same, but two people, one who passed through the gate, and one who didn't, can stand next to one another and not be able to interact at all. Volsung Fa seeks to claim this bounty on his way through the plains as he begins to unite the people. 

- **Why it’s untamed/unclaimed:** The night side of the Gealach Hills is ruled by the Wolf-king Surden. Any who have tried to close the gates or even investigate them have found themselves beset by were-creatures. 

- **Why it’s adventure worthy:** There are many who would reward handsomely to be free of the Wolf-king's realm. But if the gates were closed, what would happen to all those beyond?

# Mildred's Magical MegaBox

Mildred is an middle aged kitsune women with white hair and a bejeweled white and black mask. Her store is a large emporium of magical goods where she makes the majority of her money selling basic equipment of the the +1 magical variety. She has established herself as the primary seller of basic magical goods and as such has a working arrangement with the Silk purse. 

Mildred is a very accomplished enchanter, who studied at the College of Hanabi, and has been offered on many occasions to become a teacher in the school. She has repeatedly denied these, as she prefers the autonomy and freedom of the wealth afforded by her store. Mildred Has seen great success over the past 2 decades or so after taking the shop from the hands of her parents, long since dead. She has struck a deal with the Silk purse to provide them with enhanced equipment at a steep discount in favor for their protection and primarily, funneling equipment and resources from their trade relationships at a steeply discounted price. Her primary correspondents in the purse is Nishikibe. The 2 respect each other, but have a strictly business relationship. Mildred would certainly here out a proposition to remove herself from the silk purse, but is not in a rush. She views them as a byproduct of the city, a sort of inevitability of largness of it all. She serves one of the highest stations of state in the city, serving on the city council representing the interests of the mercantile guild of the city. As such Mildred is only at her store for a few hours a day, and spend the rest tending to matters of state in Puyi's capital building. 

Mildred sells any standard martial weapon at +1 varieties and all types of leather, medium and plate armor at a +1 as well. Use the DM guide for pricing of this equipment. She also can make +2 equipment at request, and specially +3 equipment, but at a very steep price. She also has a few specialized items in her shop, these are: 
1. The Courtesean's war fan Very rare variant - 11, 780 gp
2. The Glaive of the green tyrant Rare variant - 3,320 GP
3. A full set of Wrym's breath grenades, 1 of each variant
She will also take custom enchanting requests for the right price. 

Offers to enchant a large flying carpet for 20,000 Gp or 3000 GP to enchant a carpet using a feather of a willing thunderbird for the carpet as well.

# The Barnacle 

A tavern built entirely inside the hull of a massive, overturned galleon. The entrance is through the ripped-open cargo hole, and the "second floor" is just a maze of dangling hammocks and tilting, slanted decks. The barnacle is full of sailors and traders who use the imini river. The sailors in the tavern will be talking about the recent ghost pirate attacks in the tavern, noting the frequency seems to be increasing over the past few days. 

Run by captain Whitebeard, the slayer of the large ocean beast, in his flying dutchman ship. 

The tavern charges 1 gp a night for the stay.

	Some of the pirates will offer to play Liar's Dice with the players: They will bet no more than 20 gold pieces in a ahnd and will play no more than 3 hands of dice total

5d6 per player. 

**1. Secretly Roll**  
All players shake their 5 dice in their cups and slam them face-down on the table. Peek under your cup to see your roll, but keep it hidden from everyone else. 

**2. Place an Opening Bid**  
The first player bids on how many dice of a specific face value exist **across the entire table combined** (not just in their own cup). 

- _Example_: You have two 4s. You guess that other players have some too, so you bid _"There are at least four 4s on the table"_. 
**3. Continue Bidding (Clockwise)**  
Each subsequent player must either **raise the current bid** or **challenge it**. To raise a bid, you must: 

- Increase the **quantity** of any face value (e.g., from _four 4s_ to _five 2s_ or _five 4s_).
- Increase the **face value** while keeping the quantity the same (e.g., from _four 4s_ to _four 5s_). 
**4. Challenge the Bid ("Liar!")**  
If a player makes a bid that you believe is completely impossible, you can shout **"Liar!"** or **"Challenge!"** on your turn. This immediately ends the round. All players lift their cups to count the total matching dice. 
- **If the bid was a lie** (there are _fewer_ matching dice than the bid), the **bidder loses one die**.
- **If the bid was true** (there are _equal to or more_ matching dice than the bid), the **challenger loses one die**. 
**5. Start a New Round**  
Any player who loses all 5 of their dice is permanently eliminated from the game. The person who just lost a die starts the next round by rolling and making a new opening bid

## Kira

Kira is a Joroguma who has been secretly been stealing away family members of those visiting the graves. She offers any travelers a place to rest, in her home, as well as food and music if they would like, anything to ease their sorrow and grief. The recent earth quakes have caused the tree to split, which has a small opening that leads deeper down into Kira's lair. The other entrance is hidden in her woodshop behind a false panel in the back of a wardrobe. Kira will offer to house the players and give them a place to rest as well as any supplies they may want. 

If the player's happen to have a dead party member with them, she will show them to an empty plot of land, hoping that 
Her house is a fairly large cottage with a guest quarters on the second floor, a total of 3 rooms, and a large hearth on the first. Kira has a wood working area where she constructs any repairs to gravestones or pathways. She also has a harp in the hearth area that she will play during dinner. 

She serves hearty vegetable stews made from tubers she finds around the tree. She charges the adventurers nothing, but many will leave her donations for upkeep of the graveyard.
She has been amassing hundreds of kills over the years, her lair a large subterrain hole below the tree with the sacred tablet of Lei Shan and the skeletons of her past kills.

## Temple of Golden Rain

Location of the temple well from the module, but also houses the golden armband desired by [[Muchu-Nata]]'s backstory, and is also one of the folklore stories from [[Mirran]]'s backstory. The golden armband was lost by [[Ashura]] long ago, and had since been possessed by a tsukumogami who is able to produce 1 gp a day to someone if it desires. The ring is simply resting in the temple, which is largely used for public events in town. The ring rests on the gift alter in the center of the temple. It has not found "friend" in some time and believes the monks too dull to keep it entertained. When the players first encounter it, it will telepathically communicate with them, wondering if they are worthy of the band. 

In reality the yokai simply wants someone to play with it, as it attempts to hide from them, piloting the band around the temple to various places, if they play along it will invoke the magical power of the band and produce a single gold piece. With some coaxing and convincing, it will even accompany them, believing the temple to be quite the dull place. 

Nystul's magic Aura has been cast on the band to hid its true nature and celestial tie to Ashura. The band's "aura" is one of transmutation magic, the enchantment that produces a single gold each time. In reality this band is an artifact of Ashura, and helps to restore him to his former glory. 

The artifact of Ashura that lies underneath is a specially infused with the essence of Ashura, granting the user increased strength, but cursing them with blood lust. 

The temple well has been supplying the town with the majority of recent water, but it has recently been drying up. 

A monk named George (normal accent) provided the party with information regarding the Golden temple and some of the history of the town. West of the town, about 1 hours walk away.

NOTE BLOCK CONTENT:

The basin is huge, a 20 mile diameter crater with various spires and small islands jutting out of the crater proper. These spires are over a mile high in some places, with small tunnels that snake all throughout.  Collectively those who live in the basin are regarded as citizens of the city state of Tetsumine. These spires are home to the spire folk,  a group of miners and "blue" color people who live and work in the spire, mining resources and farming the algoy that exists in the basin. These people are artisans as well many skilled metal workers live in the spires, outputting one of the basin's most sought after exports,  metallic jewelry made from precious gold. 

Around the ring of the crater the ringlanders farm the runoff water streams from the basin into downstream hydroponic farms and lumber mills. The ringlanders trade wood and farmed animals for ore, ingots, and jewelry that the spire folk produce. 

A reclusive group of monks arrived at the basin ~ 3 months ago, and havent been heard from since like chartered a boat from Bo over to the Iron Spire. Unbenowst to the people of the basin the monks are members of the Eyes of the storm, a group of cultist who believe that Lei Shen can be brought back to the material Plane. To do so they plan to enrage Raiko by placing his stolen bead upon an iron altar from long ago. If they can retrieve a bead active with power from the Raiko, then they can use this to bring Lei Shen back from the dead. They plan to engage Raiko and allow his fury to take its course, and hope the realm, dispatches people to help slay the kaiju so they can claim the bead in the aftermath. The stolen bead of Lei Shen the monks plan to use to enrage Raiko even further was the ceramic bead that Mirran found long ago, and was murdered to find and possess. 

The rest of the information on the IronSpire is as reads in the book. 

While in the basin, a clock is counting down. The storm begins to increase in size with each passing day, expanding larger and larger from the ironspire in the center of the basin. If 10 days go by without the party intervening, the cult will have brought Raiko back down to the prime material, in his material form to the basin. He proceeds to rampage all across the basin, causing untoward havoc. 
## Shinihai Flats

The primary area that the ringlanders inhabit the flats are a lush riverbed fed from the runoff of the caldera of the basin. The ringlanders farm both lumber and livestock that they use to trade with the spire folk.

## Ancient Copper Spire -  Copper Number 13 

The spirefolk of old sought to mine out the copper of the spire during the bronze age of Shen Ji. When smelted together with tin, the ore formed a strong and plentiful metal that was used by the kingdom to fuel the technological developments of the realm. Copper spire #13 was found towards the beginning of the bronze age, and was found to be quite special. Deep within the spire, a thin connection between the elemental realm of fire has caused latent magics to leak through and cause strange arcano metallic manifestations in the metals. In particular they found that the copper, when resonating, formed an anti magical barrier in a radius around it. This prompted high demand for the copper from this spire , as it can be infused into other metallic implements in order to create magically nullifying implements( bells, shields, necklaces).

The spirefolk of old began to construct spell forges in this spire, large arcanoforges where they attempted to extract the magical properties of the arcanometals they were farming, attempting to create new spells, and place the properties of the metal into other objects. 

The spirefolk of old prioritized this spire and dug deep and fast, excavating this spire in its entirety. The deep they dug, the thinner the veil between the plane of fire and the prime material became, eventually discovering a rift deep beneath the spire itself. Through this rift came the incursion of the red oni, wrathful angry oni from the realm of fire, who sought to break into the prime material and form clans of their own on the prime material plane.

##### Arch mage quarters

The archmage of the spire and the fight against the oni king was name Malgi Copperbeard. Magli was a dwarf of old who was obsessed with the idea of infusing metals with the power of magic. He envisioned a world where even those without innate magical ability could access magics by carrying magically imbued equipment with them that could cast all manner of magics. He saw a world where magic helps to equalize and help others, not drive a divide between the magical and non magical creatures. 
His quarters are a deluge of long forgotten projects, tinkering materials and ingots of copper strewn about some pulsing with magical energies. 

* arcana check 15 + will reveal these copper ingots have been painstakingly carved with magical runes across the surface. The copper seems to resonate with magics in some of the ingots. *
His quarters contain a bed and large workbench area that contains all of these experiments. Additionally there is a locked chest at the base of his bed. In the chest are his notes. Of note from these are the following passages, written in drawvish: 

1. Suspicions are correct. Metals pulled from this spire seem to be more receptive to infusion, likely due to close proximity to elemental plane thinning. These will make excellent candidates for the creation of various arcano-metal experiments. Copper is not the most ideal metal for weapon and armor purposes, but will have to do for now.
2. Its proving difficult to allow the metal to retain magical properties after infusion. Runic engraving process is manual and painstaking, requiring many hours for a single ingot. Furthermore, working the ingot causes the symbology to break and significantly weakens or destroys the magical enchantment. The problem lies in infusion of magics into the very being of the metal
3. Construction of the spell forge began today. The large tuning rods should act as sufficient spellcasting focuses to infuse during the forging process. This will allow for infusion during the forging of the ingot, hopefully allowing for magical infusion into the molten metal, leading to stability later on during the manufacturing process
4. Spell forge construction has completed, and the first test was quite strenuous. Initial technique of simply "shotgun blasting" enchantment magics into the motel metal had some success. The product is crude however, not allowing for granular fine tuning of the spell parameters and serves no real additional benefit over simply enchanting an item in the first place(minus material cost).
5. It came in a dream last night. the lightbulb moment if you will. It would be nigh impossible to etch runes of enchantment into the surface of molten metals, and finetuning the enchantment process would lead to a delicacy that is near impossible with the existing tuning rods present. I have been thinking of the problem all wrong, the magical potential of the metals is not meant to be infused during the forging process, but rather enhanced. One must consider these metals as a sponge, ready to accept magics imparted onto them, because they themselves have some amount of magical propensity. Imagine instead we prime these sponges but extracting as much water as we can from them, removing the magical properties already present, creating a void, a dried sponge ready to suck magics up like water.
6. EUREKA. It worked. The tuning rods have been repurposed as extraction rods. The new spell is working splendidly. It took months to prepare, but the magic functions as intended a bit of permutation of the 2 spells and has created, what I will call Magli's Mootification... hmmm. Name is WIP.

##### Pools of reflection
**The Empty Gauntlet** There is a shallow water well with stone walls in a small round room, only one way in, the room is about 10-15 feet across. At the far side of the well, a stone statue stands with one arm raised in a fist, index finger pointing to the ground. The other hand holds a tablet with runes translating to: _'Be humbled, trespasser... you believe your destination is beneath you but you mustn't miss the point.'_ In the water, about 2 feet down, a metal gauntlet hovers magically, glowing blue in the clear water, fingers outstretched toward the statue. The gauntlet is immovable unless worn. The water level rests 1.5 feet above the gauntlet.

_Action:_ The door mechanism is activated by placing a hand in the gauntlet. Once a hand is placed into the gauntlet, and any motion is made with the hand or fingers, it rotates freely in 360 degrees, but clasps the wrist of the wearer, unable to remove their hand. The floor of the well starts mechanically dropping and filling with water, pulling the gauntlet and the wearer with it. The wearer must solve the door puzzle before drowning.

_Solution:_ The wearer must mimic the hand gesture of the statue, pointing down. The clue is in the runes. The hand gesture activates the door, which stops the flow of water, reverses bottom of the well, releases the hand of the wearer, and then starts to drop the floor of the entire room, well included, into another room below. The entire room acts as the point of entry. (edit for clarity)

## Iron Spire 

	Eyes of Thunder
	A group of monks who wish to bring Lei Shen back to the world of the living.   They believe that gathering enough artifacts of power and taking them to his tomb beneath Puyi will bring suffcient powers back to him to resurect him from the dead. The Eyes of Thunder heard tell a few years ago that one of the tempest orbs long lost to Lei Shen had been found in the Hakuryu Valley. They killed the yound girl who had the orb and set off to study a way to empower the orb again, assembling one of the long lost artifacts of Lei Shen. They discovered that Raiko, a raiju of great power, could be coaxed back into the prime amterial plane, and hatched a plan to enrage him on the iron spire, and using the collatoral of his enraged onslaught as a way to empower the orb. 

The eyes of the Thunder have the same goals as the eyes of iron, and have been repairing and preparing the statue of the iron wyrm they will use to open a portal to the plane of earth.  The Eyes of thunder have been holed up in the monastery for a bout a month, using the time to plan and research the best way to capture the errant energies of Raiko after his summoning. They devised a clever lightning trap, a ball of iron surrounded by lightning rods, that has been formed around the ceramic bead. 

The monastery is a large round building about 100 feet in diameter with 4 doorways on each cardinal direction. 15 monks are in the monastery, their leader a man named Brother Kaitan. 1 of the other monks is a tengu man named Jens who was involved in the murder of Mirran. He has a tinge of recognition and surprise that runs across his face when he sees Mirran. DC 17 passive perception or insight check will have the character recognize it as a look a recognition. 

The northern most door leads to the sleep quarters where the monks have been sleeping. DC 15 investigation check in the room will reveal a few trunks under the beds of some of the monks.
The trunks contains black robes robes and strange masks made of silver formed into the visage of expressionless faces. 

The southern door leads to a staircase the leads up to the domed section where the monks have been building the iron wyrm statue. A few of the monks are actively working on the statue now, patching up the gargantuan statue of an iron wrym. 

A DC 15 check (history or investigation) reveals the statue to have a section carved for the holding of a semi spherical object 

The eastern door leads to a prayer room that is decorated and dedicated to Tyr, the god of order. The monks are pretending to be disciples of Tyr, and some are "praying" to Tyr in the room. 

A DC 17 insight check will reveal the monks are not praying for real, it becomes obvious that they are putting up a farce. If confronted about thier actions they will not reveal their true purpose, unless physically harmed. If backed into a corner they will divulge the true purpose, only to save life and limb.

The western door is locked. A DC 17 thieves tool check will unlock the lock. which is a supply closet inside which the iron ball trap detailed above. 

There is a simple subterrain cave system below is where some of the monks are sleeping to stave off the storm. There is a secret tunnel system down here that the monks will use to make their escape deeper into the ironspire after they finish construction of the statue. 

Brother Kaitan insists the players can provide escort for them they can leave the next morning. They have been harried by the storm and elementals and are running out of food. The storm has been getting worse and they are ready to leave. When pressed on what they are doing the monks will explain that they came to this temple of try to restore it on a holy pilgrimage. They have rebuilt and restored the monastery in his name, and when they arrived the storm began. 

After slaying or subduing Raiko, Bologar will explain he chased the monks deeper into the spire where he managed to kill one of them, but the remaining scurried away. The Eyes of thunder continue their schemes to bring Leishen back to power. 

Bologar swears it his goal to ensure the Eyes of Thunder are kept from causing any further harm. He swears to do all in his power to ensure they are slain on site. 

The Rising blossom attaché Chuji is in town, interested in trading with the miners on the spire in order to get materials for weapons. He will even ask the players if he can buy the Raikyu for 200 gold from theme, seeking to use it to fuel the research of weapons for the rebellion/ 

Nishikibe will have arrived in town the morning the players ariive back in the Shinihai flats. Nishikibe has come to investigate the recent lag in mineral production. He has heard that Chuji has requested to divert some ore production away from the purse, and seeks to confront him to convince him to go elsewhere for production. offerring to sell him some ore at a upmarked wholesale price, or even buy him out. The players will overhear them discussing at one of the tables at the inn with Chuji becoming enraged at the offer. 

Nishsikibe will eventually confront the players late in the night and ask if he hire them to kill Chuji.  

Captain Totsuka will offer to resurrect the players allies, but would like to deduct the cost of the materials from the reward if possible.

"I was born into the Blue Blaze. A nomadic people’s group who lived mostly off of the
land. Occasionally we send our most respected into nearby towns to trade, and gather
information. We sought tales of powerful beasts and Yokai that endangered others. If we caught
wind of such creatures, we tracked them down and sent our warriors to remove the threat, and
our craftspeople turned their corpses into weapons, armor, clothes, and potions. The best kept
within the troop, while some were provided as trading goods or gifts for peaceful travel through
others lands. I was an only child, but it didn’t feel that way in the troop. All the children were
cared for by everyone. As I grew older, I grew stronger, and it was clear that my path was to
become one of the warriors of the group. I trained and trained and upon my 15th birthday I
joined in my first fight. After I proved myself against a swarm of giant centipedes, I was accepted
into our vanguard, fighting alongside my father and my tribal brothers and sisters. We always
had occasional injuries, and a few loses here and there against more threatening opponents, but
the troop remained strong. That was until a few years ago, just after I had reach 32 years of age.
We had heard rumors of Kaiju sightings in a nearby town, a new age of turmoil had begun. It
was told in our troops history that during the previous age of Kaiju we had tracked kaiju and
followed in their footsteps. Not because we stood a chance in defeating them, however chaos
also seemed to follow. Escalations of the local fauna, beasts and yokai seemed to be enraged in
their wake. And we would be there to slay them, to stop them, to hunt them. While this time
would be the most dangerous for our troop, its also our truest, what we were meant to do. But
this time it was different. The kaiju we were following seemed to vanish. We couldn't find any
trace of it. And when we began to camp and spread out to pick up signs of it, it was too late.
Was it an ambush, did we miss something, or was it sheer randomness, I’ll never know. But
before we knew it the Kaiju was upon us, and it seems we did something to incur its wrath. I
grabbed my Kanabo and charged into the fray, doing my best to try and defend those who
couldn't defend themselves. But what chance did I have? I was smashed against the ground and
flung across the camp. I tumbled down a nearby hill into the forest below. As my pain and
injuries got the better of me, I lost consciousness as I heard the screams of my troop being
slaughtered. I thought I died, but eventually I opened my eyes once more. And before me a
vision of the most beautiful woman I had and will ever see. She told me heard the commotion
and when she got closer to look she saw me tumble down into the forest beside her. She
brought me to her hideout in the woods and brought me back from the brink. I couldn’t believe it,
my people were gone and this woman saved me? I wanted to go back, to see for myself, but my
wounds were too severe. I was stuck here. I swore revenge on the kaiju, but I thought I would
never recover to the level to pick up a weapon again, let alone travel and fight. But this woman,
she healed me, more than what should be possible. As we talked and grew closer, she revealed
that she was no normal woman, but a yokai. She used her powers to repair me, to make me
strong again. After a few months, I was strong enough to leave, but I had grown fond of her
company. I asked if she wished to travel with me, to find others that could help me slay this Kaiju and protect others from the fate my troop endured. She agreed, and we traveled the realm for
the next couple of years. However, she revealed to me that she too had been wounded. She
wasn’t sure by what, a curse, an illness, the imbalance of the world? Something was taking a
toll, and with each passing moment she grew ever so slightly weaker. I did my best to provide for
us as we traveled, hunting down small beasts, trading the meats and pelts for food, lodging and
medicines. They seemed to help her condition, but just for a short while, and before long she
grew even weaker. I vowed that just as she cared for me, I would do the same for her. Maybe it
was our situations, maybe it was the time spent on the road, just the two of us. But as we grew
closer together, a fondness for each other deepened. And we fell in love. But my love continued
to wither before me. Soon she would be too weak to travel. We eventually stumbled across a
shrine to yokai deep in the forest outside a very small town. An aasimar monk, the only holy
person at the shrine, took pity on us. Alleia said that she would look after (yokai love) and do her
best to steady her health, while I trekked on, looking for stronger remedies. I took one final look
at my love, and promised her I would return, to bring her something that would fix her ailment,
and that eventually we would travel the world together again. Just the two of us. So now I set
forth seeking a band of adventurers who wish to slay stronger and more powerful creatures
eventually Kaiju so that I can gather even more powerful ingredients for remedies for my love.
And, if we can protect innocents along the way, even better."

A kitsune tamaya rogue, Nisuke was a common thief who patrolled the streets of [[Puyi]] looking for the next big score to fill his pockets with gold. After overhearing tell of a fantastic new arcanomech technology developed by the [[College of Hanabi]], Nisuki couldn't help but try his hand at "acquiring" some of the tech for himself. She underestimated the savviness one Professor Bombuku, who caught him red handed in the act. Bombuku saw opportunity and promise in the entrepreneurial kitsune, and struck up a deal with him. In exchange for his help and services, he wouldn't report him to the authorities, and would even provide her with a steady employment and stream of income. He enlisted his help in procuring some of the more hard to find materials for his research, employing her to use whatever methods she saw fit for acquisition. The swords of kihoso drag the corpse of Tie through the forest to the Tree of Life, a massive oak tree that spans over a graveyard at its base. They found the graveyard was being tended by a beautiful young women named Kira. Kira welcomed them in with open arms, and introduced them to her other guest, a Doctor and his travelling companion.  They had a warm hearty meal, and went off to bed after some tales around the fire. Muchu decided to sleep outside, where Kira came to fetch him in the wee hours of the night. Kira awoke him with her charming presence and led him into the basement below her home, under the tree. He asked him to wait there a while, which he initially complied. After some time, he steeled himself, realizing that he cannot be stopped and slowed down from the path he currently walked. He set fire to the inside of the hefty wooden door and began to shoot his gun in an attempt to escape. The swords awoke, heading downstairs. Initially insistent on investigating the noise, Nisuki and Mirrin began to assure everyone that things are fine and they should just go back upstairs. 

Combat with Kira raged on, her commanding her new "allies" to aid her and not allow the others to leave her cabin. The party found themselves divided in action, eventually leading to the death of both Kira, and Crabagail. The swords of Kihoso decide to bury both Kira and Crabagail in the wake of the battle and continue down the path towards the Tetsumine Basin. Along the way, they began to forge bonds and alliances within the group itself, some strengthening, and others weakening. The Swords continued on until they came across a strange new Isetsu, a crab person named Chris Tacian. Onwards still they eventually made their way to the Tetsumine Basin, which they now sit on the very edge of, looking out towards the rolling storm in the center of the crater.

NOTE BLOCK CONTENT:

- Players meet at the westward road that leads through the Tofuoka Hills towards Kihoso
- The road leads through the acidic hills about 5-6 hours journey by Arthopod 
- They will encounter a small town along the way, conducting a funereal procession in one of the kihomes. The procession is led by a monk clad in chitinous robes. The monk carries a corpse, and a Kasha attempt to reach the corpse and eat it.
	- The town is called Tofua Town, they produce the saddles used to ride the mounted arthopods(millipedes, dragonflies, rhinocerous beetles)
	- The town is also home to a monastery of warrior monks. The ancient texts in the temple are dedicated to an ancient warrior god by the name of Ashura
	- The ancient texts are kept under lock and key in the center of the monastery
	- Very close inspection of the text reveals a section written in Abyssal in the back of the book
		- The abyssal text details the hidden story of Ashura, a god of great might and power. He grew fat on his pride, and challenged all other gods to face him in a battle of strength. Over the next 100 years Ashura held a tournament of the gods, challenging each one to approach and attempt to defeat him. One by one they fell before him, until a small of form goddess with 6 arms challenged him. Her name was Tennen, and she stroked Ashura's ego, telling him over and over how strong he truly was. In that time she managed to lull him into a state of boasting and complacency, when she struck a single blow to the back of his head. In that moment Ashura fell, stripped of all of his titles and royal garb. It is believed Ashura walks among the living now, in one form or another. 
- Can roll for random encounter along the way again(depending on vibes) for encounter with a kabuto who is enraged by a nearby earthquake caused by Nomi
- After the 5 hour journey the players will reach the town of [[Kihoso]]
- The caravan will stop at the edge of town and let the players off and allow them to explore the town
- After reaching the town of kihoso, they will reach level 2. 
- Before the ship with the water shipment arrives the players are sent on a mission to help calm the some of the wild Kabuto on the edge of town. Recent earthquakes have caused them to become strangely aggressive. The players will see one larger Kabuto with scars on it that is constantly fighting with the other males. This alpha kabuto has been seeking out challengers, and has been stirred by Nomi's pheromones. The players will need to neutralize this kabuto by either defeating it in a wrestling match, or killing it outright. The knowledge they will have will depend on if they have visited  the fighting pits yet. The Dr will be at the fighting pits the second night after the water caravan arrives. 
- The alpha Kabuto the players fight will have the materials needed for the blacksmith quest upon a successful harvest. They will also find that this small wild Kabuto nest is home to 5 females who are all laying their eggs in a nearby acidified pond of water. 
- The acid here is weak, but Bombuku will take a sample and conclude it is not quite what he was looking for. He will detail a contact of his (the doctor) sent him something much stronger

Synopsis: 
The players converged on the nexus of the path westward towards the city of Kihoso. With some introductions made amongst new traveling companions they boarded the "bug bus" a large Rhinoceros beetle with a carriage affixed to its back. They boarded the beetle, with Mirran smearing her pheromones onto the bugs head, and it began to travel along the road to the west. Along they way they came across their first yokai encounter, a Kasha attempting to steal the corpse of a monk of the Fists of Ashara. Killing the Kasha and helping the monks, they invited the party in for some tea. The party learned that the water in the town was slightly acidic and advised the town to move eastward to save themselves as they believed it may only get worse. They told the party as well that the kabuto beetles in the area had been acting strangely aggressive as well  as exhibiting some strange behavior. Continuing on the players came across 2 a smaller kabuto fighting alongside the road, engaging in a wrestling match, with one emerging victorious in pinning the other, causing it to walk away with its head held in defeat. Upon reaching the end of the road, the party arrived at a large tori gate that signals entry into the city of Kihoso.

## Town Blacksmith

The Chitinous Shell is run by a Dwarven man named Beltharn Bloodfist. Beltharn has lived in Kihoso all his life and primary creates specialty chiton armor from the parts of Kabuto. These items are equivalent to their normal counterparts but give resistance to acid damage. They are 50 percent more expensive than their normal counterparts. In exchange for enough Kabuto parts to create a new piece of heavy chitin armor, he will teach the players how to create the Chitinous armor. 

Beltharn is a representative of the rising blossoms and will ask the party for help if they inquire about the state of the town. He will provide the rising blossoms Adventure hook. 

He will also show the players his schematics for his advanced designs if they ask - these are the nomi specific items.

## Temple of Golden Rain

Location of the temple well from the module, but also houses the golden armband desired by [[Muchu-Nata]]'s backstory, and is also one of the folklore stories from [[Mirran]]'s backstory. The golden armband was lost by [[Ashura]] long ago, and had since been possessed by a tsukumogami who is able to produce 1 gp a day to someone if it desires. The ring is simply resting in the temple, which is largely used for public events in town. The ring rests on the gift alter in the center of the temple. It has not found "friend" in some time and believes the monks too dull to keep it entertained. When the players first encounter it, it will telepathically communicate with them, wondering if they are worthy of the band. 

In reality the yokai simply wants someone to play with it, as it attempts to hide from them, piloting the band around the temple to various places, if they play along it will invoke the magical power of the band and produce a single gold piece. With some coaxing and convincing, it will even accompany them, believing the temple to be quite the dull place. 

Nystul's magic Aura has been cast on the band to hid its true nature and celestial tie to Ashura. The band's "aura" is one of transmutation magic, the enchantment that produces a single gold each time. In reality this band is an artifact of Ashura, and helps to restore him to his former glory. 

The artifact of Ashura that lies underneath is a specially infused with the essence of Ashura, granting the user increased strength, but cursing them with blood lust. 

The temple well has been supplying the town with the majority of recent water, but it has recently been drying up. 

A monk named George (normal accent) provided the party with information regarding the Golden temple and some of the history of the town. West of the town, about 1 hours walk away.

He notes as well that some of the male Kabuto in the area have been acting more aggressive. Typically the Kabuto don't bother others as long as the eggs are left alone, the male Kabuto have begun to aggressively charge anyone who gets too close. 

The kabuto hive has been dug up by a male kabuto who is especially large. This male has been digging deeper and deeper trying to get closer to Nomi. The caves have a spiral descending pattern, with other small Kihosan beetles who are following in the wake of the "Alpha male beetle". The larger male has been causing chaos in the area and stirring up the other males, killing him will decrease the aggression of the nearby Kabuto's around Kihoso.

METADATA:{"created":"2025/08/27 21:29:52","modified":"2026/02/11 17:39:29","chunkId":"Wrath of the Kaiju/History/Lei Shen.md#0","heading":"Power of the Storm"}

NOTE BLOCK CONTENT:

The last great emperor of Shen Ji, history remembers Lei Shen as the great kaiju slayer and bringer of a time of peace. History tends to forget that Lei Shen was a ruthless leader, bringing Shen Ji under the banner of the Thunder King, one of strict law and code. It was said that Lei Shen commanded the power of the storm itself, able summon and bend the power of lightning, and with this power, he was able to defeat the kaiju of the past. 

Lei Shen was born to a royal family of oniborne. The strongest of his siblings he was born to be great, and great he was. Lei Shen aspired for much more than just dominion over his nomadic troop. He saw the power of his people, the power of his claim, and decided he would unite all of Shen Ji under his banner. He sought to tame and destroy the kaiju that ravaged the land, seeing a future where the denizens of Shen Ji could be the rulers of the land, not the kaiju. In the years that followed Lei Shen led a conquest across the lands, uniting the races and tribes under his banner through all means of conquest. For those that could be reasoned with, Lei Shen offered a vision of a Shen Ji ruled by order and prosperity under a single banner. For those who could not, Lei Shen split the heavens with his righteous [[#Power of the Storm]] and made those who opposed him bend the knee. 10 years of conquest, and Lei Shen began the [[#Reign of the Thunder King]]. 
## Power of the Storm

Lei Shen stole a tempest bead from a Raiju while it slumbered. He then had a powerful shaman fuse the bead with himself, granting him great powers of thunder and lightening. He then used the very power of the kaiju to slay them and bring about the years of peace the realm knows now. 
## Reign of the Thunder King

At the start of his reign, the Thunder King led [[#The Hunt of Thunder]] to cleanse the kaiju from the realm. With Shen Ji's people free from the immense force of these behemoths, the emperor could begin to build his empire.

Lei Shen ruled Shen Ji through strength and wit. He united the people of the land under a single unified language (common). He created a single system of weight and currency that laid the foundation for society today. His reign saw the strict enforcement of law and order, with insurrection and rebellion punished by public evisceration and execution. Any and all who opposed his rule were subjected and enslaved. 

He erected the walled city of [[Puyi]], the capital of his empire which lied in the center of the [[Puyi#Thunder Plains|Thunder Plains]]. 

# The Hunt of Thunder

Once united under his powerful banner, Lei Shen began his hunt of the kaiju. Wielding the power of a Raiju infused into his body, and legions thousands strong, he was a force to be reckoned with. The Thunder King was no fool, he knew some of the kaiju could be placated in his study of historical text, and employed a vast manner of  cunning and clever tactics to reason with and

"I was born into the Blue Blaze. A nomadic people’s group who lived mostly off of the
land. Occasionally we send our most respected into nearby towns to trade, and gather
information. We sought tales of powerful beasts and Yokai that endangered others. If we caught
wind of such creatures, we tracked them down and sent our warriors to remove the threat, and
our craftspeople turned their corpses into weapons, armor, clothes, and potions. The best kept
within the troop, while some were provided as trading goods or gifts for peaceful travel through
others lands. I was an only child, but it didn’t feel that way in the troop. All the children were
cared for by everyone. As I grew older, I grew stronger, and it was clear that my path was to
become one of the warriors of the group. I trained and trained and upon my 15th birthday I
joined in my first fight. After I proved myself against a swarm of giant centipedes, I was accepted
into our vanguard, fighting alongside my father and my tribal brothers and sisters. We always
had occasional injuries, and a few loses here and there against more threatening opponents, but
the troop remained strong. That was until a few years ago, just after I had reach 32 years of age.
We had heard rumors of Kaiju sightings in a nearby town, a new age of turmoil had begun. It
was told in our troops history that during the previous age of Kaiju we had tracked kaiju and
followed in their footsteps. Not because we stood a chance in defeating them, however chaos
also seemed to follow. Escalations of the local fauna, beasts and yokai seemed to be enraged in
their wake. And we would be there to slay them, to stop them, to hunt them. While this time
would be the most dangerous for our troop, its also our truest, what we were meant to do. But
this time it was different. The kaiju we were following seemed to vanish. We couldn't find any
trace of it. And when we began to camp and spread out to pick up signs of it, it was too late.
Was it an ambush, did we miss something, or was it sheer randomness, I’ll never know. But
before we knew it the Kaiju was upon us, and it seems we did something to incur its wrath. I
grabbed my Kanabo and charged into the fray, doing my best to try and defend those who
couldn't defend themselves. But what chance did I have? I was smashed against the ground and
flung across the camp. I tumbled down a nearby hill into the forest below. As my pain and
injuries got the better of me, I lost consciousness as I heard the screams of my troop being
slaughtered. I thought I died, but eventually I opened my eyes once more. And before me a
vision of the most beautiful woman I had and will ever see. She told me heard the commotion
and when she got closer to look she saw me tumble down into the forest beside her. She
brought me to her hideout in the woods and brought me back from the brink. I couldn’t believe it,
my people were gone and this woman saved me? I wanted to go back, to see for myself, but my
wounds were too severe. I was stuck here. I swore revenge on the kaiju, but I thought I would
never recover to the level to pick up a weapon again, let alone travel and fight. But this woman,
she healed me, more than what should be possible. As we talked and grew closer, she revealed
that she was no normal woman, but a yokai. She used her powers to repair me, to make me
strong again. After a few months, I was strong enough to leave, but I had grown fond of her
company. I asked if she wished to travel with me, to find others that could help me slay this Kaiju and protect others from the fate my troop endured. She agreed, and we traveled the realm for
the next couple of years. However, she revealed to me that she too had been wounded. She
wasn’t sure by what, a curse, an illness, the imbalance of the world? Something was taking a
toll, and with each passing moment she grew ever so slightly weaker. I did my best to provide for
us as we traveled, hunting down small beasts, trading the meats and pelts for food, lodging and
medicines. They seemed to help her condition, but just for a short while, and before long she
grew even weaker. I vowed that just as she cared for me, I would do the same for her. Maybe it
was our situations, maybe it was the time spent on the road, just the two of us. But as we grew
closer together, a fondness for each other deepened. And we fell in love. But my love continued
to wither before me. Soon she would be too weak to travel. We eventually stumbled across a
shrine to yokai deep in the forest outside a very small town. An aasimar monk, the only holy
person at the shrine, took pity on us. Alleia said that she would look after (yokai love) and do her
best to steady her health, while I trekked on, looking for stronger remedies. I took one final look
at my love, and promised her I would return, to bring her something that would fix her ailment,
and that eventually we would travel the world together again. Just the two of us. So now I set
forth seeking a band of adventurers who wish to slay stronger and more powerful creatures
eventually Kaiju so that I can gather even more powerful ingredients for remedies for my love.
And, if we can protect innocents along the way, even better."

The primary metropolitan center of Shen Ji, Puyi serves as the hub of trade and culture in the realm. Puyi is walled city, erected by the last great emperor of Shen Ji, [[Lei Shen]]. The city now serves as the the nexus for political and economic production, with an outlet to the sea along the Imini River, fed from the Kitikami Mountains. 

The city of Puyi was originally founded during lei Shen's rule and served as the "Rome" of his rule. The city was used to establish a cultural hub and served as the major nexus point for the gathering of the armies under his rule. As such the original ancient city was surrounded by large walls and borders the Imini river which runs both through and aside the city. From here Lei shen built the docks that allowed for ship building that later defined the northern coast, the umigiri coast as the ships left their inland post. 

Modern day Puyi is governed by a city council, a primary body of 4 Mildred Vex of Mildreds Magical MagicBox who represents the interest of the merchants of the city, the dean of the college of Hanabi, Ryu the head Chronicler at the Library of the Chroniclers, and Captain Georgio (High level Cleric) , First plume of the Pegasus Guard of Puyi.  This city council votes and discusses the usage of Puyis resources, representing each of the relevant factions of the city. The council rotates responsibly for presenting and speaking to the public regarding public events, and also each carry with them a advisory council of 2 people. The advisory council is also allowed to vote during major decisions but doesn't not speak for the group, the idea being that an individual council member cannot corrupt the decisions of any given faction. These council members are chosen by the other members of the council.

# The Barnacle 

A tavern built entirely inside the hull of a massive, overturned galleon. The entrance is through the ripped-open cargo hole, and the "second floor" is just a maze of dangling hammocks and tilting, slanted decks. The barnacle is full of sailors and traders who use the imini river. 	Some of the pirates will offer to play Liar's Dice with the players: They will bet no more than 20 gold pieces in a ahnd and will play no more than 3 hands of dice total

5d6 per player. 

**1. Secretly Roll**  
All players shake their 5 dice in their cups and slam them face-down on the table. Peek under your cup to see your roll, but keep it hidden from everyone else. 

**2. Place an Opening Bid**  
The first player bids on how many dice of a specific face value exist **across the entire table combined** (not just in their own cup). 

- _Example_: You have two 4s. You guess that other players have some too, so you bid _"There are at least four 4s on the table"_. 
**3. Continue Bidding (Clockwise)**  
Each subsequent player must either **raise the current bid** or **challenge it**. To raise a bid, you must: 

- Increase the **quantity** of any face value (e.g., from _four 4s_ to _five 2s_ or _five 4s_).
- Increase the **face value** while keeping the quantity the same (e.g., from _four 4s_ to _four 5s_). 
**4. Challenge the Bid ("Liar!")**  
If a player makes a bid that you believe is completely impossible, you can shout **"Liar!"** or **"Challenge!"** on your turn. This immediately ends the round. All players lift their cups to count the total matching dice. 
- **If the bid was a lie** (there are _fewer_ matching dice than the bid), the **bidder loses one die**.
- **If the bid was true** (there are _equal to or more_ matching dice than the bid), the **challenger loses one die**. 
**5. Start a New Round**  
Any player who loses all 5 of their dice is permanently eliminated from the game. The person who just lost a die starts the next round by rolling and making a new opening bid

# History of Shen Ji

Shen Ji is a rich and prosperous lands, home to all manner of beast, creature and spirit. The realm have been shrouded in a mist that has cut them off from the surrounding planes for a millennium, if not more. The traditional gods and goddesses of the prime material and beyond can still communicate with Shen Ji, but anything short of deific magics cannot permeate the ever present mist that surrounds the realm. 

Despite this "seclusion" the beings of this place thrive, and have no desire to leave. The realms also harbors a unique ecosystem, one where the spirts of this realm, the Yokai, are present in all walks of life. Even more strange then the yokai though, are the [[#Kaiju]], colossal forces of nature that shape the very land they walk upon. 

It has been 1000 years since the [[Lei Shen]], and Shen Ji has known relative peace. A time during which the realm has prospered, allowing for the blossoming of society and order. It seems that time of peace and prosperity may be threatened, as in the past few years, the ground itself has begun to sunder, the mountains have begun to move, the storms have begun to rage. Kaiju have been spotted.
# [[Kaiju]]

Kaiju are gargantuan creatures that inhabit Shen Ji. These forces of nature take many forms, massive kabuto beetles, bipedal Raiju, or leviathans made of spiritual water, but share one common trait: their existence shapes the very realm itself. These creatures can cleave mountains with a swipe of a tail, flood a valley with wanton breath, and level entire towns when lying down to rest. Each kaiju is motivated by it's own personal agenda, these creatures are not controlled or manipulated for some higher purpose, they simply exist as sheer power incarnate. 

Kaiju cannot truly be slain, no more so than a storm can be "killed". The death of a kaiju signals the beginning of a cycle of rebirth, some thousands of years in the future, it will be reborn again, ready to wreck havoc once more.

##### Arch mage quarters

The archmage of the spire and the fight against the oni king was name Malgi Copperbeard. Magli was a dwarf of old who was obsessed with the idea of infusing metals with the power of magic. He envisioned a world where even those without innate magical ability could access magics by carrying magically imbued equipment with them that could cast all manner of magics. He saw a world where magic helps to equalize and help others, not drive a divide between the magical and non magical creatures. 
His quarters are a deluge of long forgotten projects, tinkering materials and ingots of copper strewn about some pulsing with magical energies. 

* arcana check 15 + will reveal these copper ingots have been painstakingly carved with magical runes across the surface. The copper seems to resonate with magics in some of the ingots. *
His quarters contain a bed and large workbench area that contains all of these experiments. Additionally there is a locked chest at the base of his bed. In the chest are his notes. Of note from these are the following passages, written in drawvish: 

1. Suspicions are correct. Metals pulled from this spire seem to be more receptive to infusion, likely due to close proximity to elemental plane thinning. These will make excellent candidates for the creation of various arcano-metal experiments. Copper is not the most ideal metal for weapon and armor purposes, but will have to do for now.
2. Its proving difficult to allow the metal to retain magical properties after infusion. Runic engraving process is manual and painstaking, requiring many hours for a single ingot. Furthermore, working the ingot causes the symbology to break and significantly weakens or destroys the magical enchantment. The problem lies in infusion of magics into the very being of the metal
3. Construction of the spell forge began today. The large tuning rods should act as sufficient spellcasting focuses to infuse during the forging process. This will allow for infusion during the forging of the ingot, hopefully allowing for magical infusion into the molten metal, leading to stability later on during the manufacturing process
4. Spell forge construction has completed, and the first test was quite strenuous. Initial technique of simply "shotgun blasting" enchantment magics into the motel metal had some success. The product is crude however, not allowing for granular fine tuning of the spell parameters and serves no real additional benefit over simply enchanting an item in the first place(minus material cost).
5. It came in a dream last night. the lightbulb moment if you will. It would be nigh impossible to etch runes of enchantment into the surface of molten metals, and finetuning the enchantment process would lead to a delicacy that is near impossible with the existing tuning rods present. I have been thinking of the problem all wrong, the magical potential of the metals is not meant to be infused during the forging process, but rather enhanced. One must consider these metals as a sponge, ready to accept magics imparted onto them, because they themselves have some amount of magical propensity. Imagine instead we prime these sponges but extracting as much water as we can from them, removing the magical properties already present, creating a void, a dried sponge ready to suck magics up like water.
6. EUREKA. It worked. The tuning rods have been repurposed as extraction rods. The new spell is working splendidly. It took months to prepare, but the magic functions as intended a bit of permutation of the 2 spells and has created, what I will call Magli's Mootification... hmmm. Name is WIP.

The hand gesture activates the door, which stops the flow of water, reverses bottom of the well, releases the hand of the wearer, and then starts to drop the floor of the entire room, well included, into another room below. ## Iron Spire 

	Eyes of Thunder
	A group of monks who wish to bring Lei Shen back to the world of the living.   They believe that gathering enough artifacts of power and taking them to his tomb beneath Puyi will bring suffcient powers back to him to resurect him from the dead. The Eyes of Thunder heard tell a few years ago that one of the tempest orbs long lost to Lei Shen had been found in the Hakuryu Valley. They killed the yound girl who had the orb and set off to study a way to empower the orb again, assembling one of the long lost artifacts of Lei Shen. They discovered that Raiko, a raiju of great power, could be coaxed back into the prime amterial plane, and hatched a plan to enrage him on the iron spire, and using the collatoral of his enraged onslaught as a way to empower the orb. 

The eyes of the Thunder have the same goals as the eyes of iron, and have been repairing and preparing the statue of the iron wyrm they will use to open a portal to the plane of earth.  The Eyes of thunder have been holed up in the monastery for a bout a month, using the time to plan and research the best way to capture the errant energies of Raiko after his summoning. They devised a clever lightning trap, a ball of iron surrounded by lightning rods, that has been formed around the ceramic bead. 

The monastery is a large round building about 100 feet in diameter with 4 doorways on each cardinal direction. 15 monks are in the monastery, their leader a man named Brother Kaitan. 1 of the other monks is a tengu man named Jens who was involved in the murder of Mirran. He has a tinge of recognition and surprise that runs across his face when he sees Mirran. DC 17 passive perception or insight check will have the character recognize it as a look a recognition. 

The northern most door leads to the sleep quarters where the monks have been sleeping. DC 15 investigation check in the room will reveal a few trunks under the beds of some of the monks.
The trunks contains black robes robes and strange masks made of silver formed into the visage of expressionless faces. 

The southern door leads to a staircase the leads up to the domed section where the monks have been building the iron wyrm statue. A few of the monks are actively working on the statue now, patching up the gargantuan statue of an iron wrym. 

A DC 15 check (history or investigation) reveals the statue to have a section carved for the holding of a semi spherical object 

The eastern door leads to a prayer room that is decorated and dedicated to Tyr, the god of order. The monks are pretending to be disciples of Tyr, and some are "praying" to Tyr in the room. 

A DC 17 insight check will reveal the monks are not praying for real, it becomes obvious that they are putting up a farce. If confronted about thier actions they will not reveal their true purpose, unless physically harmed. If backed into a corner they will divulge the true purpose, only to save life and limb.

The western door is locked. A DC 17 thieves tool check will unlock the lock. which is a supply closet inside which the iron ball trap detailed above. 

There is a simple subterrain cave system below is where some of the monks are sleeping to stave off the storm. There is a secret tunnel system down here that the monks will use to make their escape deeper into the ironspire after they finish construction of the statue. 

Brother Kaitan insists the players can provide escort for them they can leave the next morning. They have been harried by the storm and elementals and are running out of food. The storm has been getting worse and they are ready to leave. When pressed on what they are doing the monks will explain that they came to this temple of try to restore it on a holy pilgrimage. They have rebuilt and restored the monastery in his name, and when they arrived the storm began. 

After slaying or subduing Raiko, Bologar will explain he chased the monks deeper into the spire where he managed to kill one of them, but the remaining scurried away. The Eyes of thunder continue their schemes to bring Leishen back to power. 

Bologar swears it his goal to ensure the Eyes of Thunder are kept from causing any further harm. He swears to do all in his power to ensure they are slain on site.

He has heard that Chuji has requested to divert some ore production away from the purse, and seeks to confront him to convince him to go elsewhere for production. offerring to sell him some ore at a upmarked wholesale price, or even buy him out. The players will overhear them discussing at one of the tables at the inn with Chuji becoming enraged at the offer.

## Ancient Copper Spire -  Copper Number 13 

The spirefolk of old sought to mine out the copper of the spire during the bronze age of Shen Ji. When smelted together with tin, the ore formed a strong and plentiful metal that was used by the kingdom to fuel the technological developments of the realm. Copper spire #13 was found towards the beginning of the bronze age, and was found to be quite special. Deep within the spire, a thin connection between the elemental realm of fire has caused latent magics to leak through and cause strange arcano metallic manifestations in the metals. In particular they found that the copper, when resonating, formed an anti magical barrier in a radius around it. This prompted high demand for the copper from this spire , as it can be infused into other metallic implements in order to create magically nullifying implements( bells, shields, necklaces).

The spirefolk of old began to construct spell forges in this spire, large arcanoforges where they attempted to extract the magical properties of the arcanometals they were farming, attempting to create new spells, and place the properties of the metal into other objects. 

The spirefolk of old prioritized this spire and dug deep and fast, excavating this spire in its entirety. The deep they dug, the thinner the veil between the plane of fire and the prime material became, eventually discovering a rift deep beneath the spire itself. Through this rift came the incursion of the red oni, wrathful angry oni from the realm of fire, who sought to break into the prime material and form clans of their own on the prime material plane.
